verdict.rationale: Lambda's filesystem docs describe an S3-compatible adapter that lets developers copy files to and from attached regional filesystems using standard tools like rclone and s5cmd. That covers the S3-compatible endpoint and documented transfer tooling at the core of the story. missing for 10: endpoint setup/authentication details, throughput or performance documentation, explicit cloud-storage sync workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can move data in and out efficiently — S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync, or documented transfer tooling

citations.quote: This adapter allows you to use S3-compatible tools like rclone and s5cmd to copy files to and from your filesystems and perform common file operations.
A filesystem is a high-capacity regional file store you can attach to your instance to store datasets and back up system state.
